richiami.difetto: The fixed rear quarter glass may separate from the vehicle whilst in motion
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace Quarter Glass assembly
richiami.titolo: REAR QUARTER WINDOW MAY DETACH FROM VEHICLE

richiami.difetto: The blower motor may under certain operating conditions overheat and cause an interior fire
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit modified blower motor.
richiami.titolo: RISK OF FIRE

richiami.difetto: Under certain operating conditions it has been identified that the engine might stall due to incorrect programming of the totally integrated power module (TIPM).
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the TPIM re-programmed.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY STALL

richiami.difetto: Insufficient grease may have been applied to the front wheel bearings which could result in the very worst cases in detachment of the wheel and hub.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the front wheel bearings.
richiami.titolo: WHEEL SEPERATION MAY OCCUR

richiami.difetto: The product poses a serious risk of injuries because the fixed rear side windows (triangular windows) can fall out. If this happens during a journey, other vehicles may be damaged or pedestrians may be injured.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the front suspension ball joints may suffer from water ingress that can cause the joint to corrode and separate.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the front suspension ball joints replaced.
richiami.titolo: BALL JOINTS MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: The clutch pedal push rod may break causing the clutch function to be lost.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the clutch pedal push rod plastic spacer foam seal and interlock switch cover.
richiami.titolo: VEHICLE MAY STALL

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the front passenger air bag may deploy with too much force when certain rear facing child seats are installed.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the front passenger cushions replaced and the occupant restraint system re-programmed.
richiami.titolo: FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the front passenger seat belts may not tighten on certain models of child seat.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the front passenger seat belts replaced.
richiami.titolo: CONCERN THAT SEATBELT WILL NOT SECURE CHILDSEAT

richiami.difetto: The cooling fan blades may fracture and separate from the fan which will in certain circumstances allow the engine to overheat.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fan assembly.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT

richiami.difetto: The cooling fan blades may fracture and separate from the fan which will in certain circumstances allow the engine to overheat.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the fan assembly.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that a number of vehicles may have a faulty absolute emissions sensor.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the manifold absolute pressure sensor replaced.
richiami.titolo: EXHAUST EMISSIONS MAY BE INCORRECT

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the direction indicators may not function correctly.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the indicator power module reprogrammed.
richiami.titolo: DIRECTION INDICATORS MAY NOT FUNCTION CORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the handbrake may fail.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the handbrake assembly replaced.
richiami.titolo: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: The windscreen wipers may fail to operate.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the windscreen wiper motor replaced.
richiami.titolo: WINDSCREEN WIPERS MAY FAIL TO OPERATE

richiami.difetto: The cup plug on the automatic transmission parking pawl may be incorrectly installed. Thus even when park is selected it may be possible that the vehicle could roll away.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have a bracket fitted to the transmission cup plug.
richiami.titolo: VEHICLE MAY ROLL AWAY

richiami.difetto: The power steering upper hose may split and leak. This may result in a fire.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace the power steering upper return hose.
richiami.titolo: THE UPPER POWER STEERING HOSE MAY SPLIT AND LEAK.

richiami.difetto: The fuel line jumper tube may chafe against the throttle cable. This may then lead to a fuel leak.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a modified fuel line jumper tube. Additionally the tube will be re-routed and secured.
richiami.titolo: THE FUEL LINE JUMPER TUBE MAY CHAFE AGAINST THE THROTTLE CABLE

richiami.difetto: The fuel pump module mounting may leak if the vehicle is involved in a rollover collision.
richiami.rimedio: Install a secondary seal over the fuel pump module.
richiami.titolo: FUEL PUMP MODULE MOUNTING CONCERN

richiami.difetto: The D pillar sound barrier patches may loosen and drop onto the rear seat belt which may lead to the seat belt assembly becoming inoperative.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicle and fit new version of foam pads to D pillar and inspect and replace any sticking or inoperative seat belts.
richiami.titolo: SEAT BELT MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE

richiami.difetto: Cracking and separation of the steering rack cross member and/or the differential mounting bracket may lead to loss of vehicle control in extreme cases.
richiami.rimedio: Recall vehicles and inspect for cracks.  If cracks are evident parts will be replaced.  In all cases reinforcement brackets will be installed.
richiami.titolo: STEERING RACK CROSS MEMBER/DIFFERENTIAL MOUNTING BRACKET CONCERN

richiami.difetto: After extended use the fuel rail crossover tube O rings may leak fuel.  This may lead to an engine compartment fire.
richiami.rimedio: Fit external seals at the fuel crossover points.  If the joints are leaking or show signs of rust the fuel rail assembly will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE COMPARTMENT FUEL LEAK CONCERN

richiami.difetto: After extended use the fuel rail crossover tube O rings may leak fuel.  This may lead to an engine compartment fire.
richiami.rimedio: Fit external seals at the fuel crossover points.  If the joints are leaking or show signs of rust the fuel rail assembly will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE COMPARTMENT FUEL LEAK CONCERN

richiami.difetto: The brake booster vacuum hose may swell and leak due to oil contamination. This could lead to loss of power brake assist and an increase in engine idle speed. This may increase the stopping distance.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the brake booster vacuum hose.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE VACUUM HOSE CONCERN

richiami.difetto: The self-adjusting mechanism may become out of range or fail to engage. Either condition could lead to the vehicle rolling away.
richiami.rimedio: Identify type of handbrake cable fitted and install short cable if not already installed. In all cases install lockout clip to the self adjust mechanism.
richiami.titolo: HAND BRAKE MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: The parking brake lever cable is too long which may cause the locking mechanism to extend beyond the last tooth of the sector when the park brake is engaged. This condition may cause the parking brake to self-release.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace parking brake cable with shorter cable. Additionally as part of the above recall the repair contained in Daimler-Chrysler Technical Service Bulletin 05i-801-99 relating to parking brake imbalance will be carried out on affected vehicles.
richiami.titolo: PARKING BRAKE MAY SELF - RELEASE

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles liquid fuel may pass through the fuel tank rollover valve (mounted in the fuel pump module) and fill the evaporative canister. This may result in driveability problems fuel odour and leakage from the canister.
richiami.rimedio: To correct this condition the fuel pump module mounted rollover valve must be replaced.
richiami.titolo: DEFECTIVE ROLL OVER VALVE MAY RESULT IN FUEL ODOUR AND LEAKS

richiami.difetto: The air bags on the subject vehicles may inadvertently deploy during a three second period after the ignition key has been turned to the off position.
richiami.rimedio: The affected vehicles are being recalled for replacement of the air bag control module.
richiami.titolo: INADVERTANT OPERATION OF AIR BAG
